result.instructions: Tools for Viral Loops, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many leads and referrals does my Viral Loops campaign have?"; "Who is at the top of my waiting list, and how many people did they refer?"; "Show the pending rewards of the participant with this email address.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Viral Loops data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run viralloops_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run viralloops_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run viralloops_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. viralloops_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: viralloops_get_campaign_stats
tools.title: Campaign stats
tools.description: Get the number of leads and the total referral count of the campaign. Viral Loops API: GET /campaign/stats.

tools.name: viralloops_get_campaign_info
tools.title: Campaign info
tools.description: Get the campaign configuration: type, template, company name, landing page, widgets and expiration. Viral Loops API: GET /campaign/data.

tools.name: viralloops_get_participant
tools.title: Get participant
tools.description: Get one participant: name, referral code, extra data, rank, referral and points totals, referrer, and pending or redeemed rewards. Viral Loops API: GET /campaign/participant/data.

email.description: Participant email address. Give this or referral_code.

referral_code.description: Participant referral code. Give this or email.

tools.name: viralloops_get_participant_rank
tools.title: Participant rank
tools.description: Get the rank of a participant on the waiting list or leaderboard. Flagged participants are not ranked. Viral Loops API: GET /campaign/participant/rank.

email.description: Participant email address. Give this or referral_code.

referral_code.description: Participant referral code. Give this or email.

tools.name: viralloops_get_participant_order
tools.title: Participant join order
tools.description: Get the order in which a participant joined (1 = first) and the total lead count. Viral Loops API: GET /campaign/participant/order.

email.description: Participant email address. Give this or referral_code.

referral_code.description: Participant referral code. Give this or email.

tools.name: viralloops_list_participant_referrals
tools.title: List participant referrals
tools.description: List the people a participant referred, with paging. Viral Loops API: GET /campaign/participant/referrals.

email.description: Participant email address. Give this or referral_code.

referral_code.description: Participant referral code. Give this or email.

conversion_status.description: Conversion status filter, as defined by the Viral Loops API.

tools.name: viralloops_get_participant_referrer
tools.title: Get participant referrer
tools.description: Get the participant who referred the given participant. Viral Loops API: GET /campaign/participant/referrer.

email.description: Participant email address. Give this or referral_code.

referral_code.description: Participant referral code. Give this or email.

tools.name: viralloops_search_participants
tools.title: Search participants
tools.description: Search the campaign participants with filters and paging. Returns results and the total count. Read-only. Viral Loops API: POST /campaign/participant/search.

tools.name: viralloops_query_participants
tools.title: Query participants
tools.description: Get data for a list of participants (by email or referral code), or for the referrals of a list of referrers. Read-only. Viral Loops API: POST /campaign/participant/query.

referrers.description: Referrers whose referred participants to return.

tools.name: viralloops_list_pending_rewards
tools.title: List pending rewards
tools.description: List pending rewards of one participant. Without email and referral code, the API returns a paged list of participants and their pending rewards (use limit and skip). Viral Loops API: GET /campaign/participant/rewards/pending.

email.description: Participant email address. Give this or referral_code.

referral_code.description: Participant referral code. Give this or email.

tools.name: viralloops_list_given_rewards
tools.title: List given rewards
tools.description: List rewards already given to one participant. Without email and referral code, the API returns a paged list of participants and their given rewards (use limit and skip). Viral Loops API: GET /campaign/participant/rewards/given.

email.description: Participant email address. Give this or referral_code.

referral_code.description: Participant referral code. Give this or email.
